acceptance_criteria.statement: AC1 CommandReceipt exposes event ID, kinds, and idempotency key.
AC2 Publish-and-wait distinguishes relay acceptance states.
AC3 Idempotency uses Nostr d tags and replay lookup.
AC4 REST long-running writes return canonical receipt shape where migrated.
AC5 MCP deploy/rollback use command publisher when configured.
AC6 CLI requests generate deterministic idempotency keys.

rollout_gates.gate: Receipt-producing routes preserve documented synchronous compatibility exceptions.
No command is considered accepted without relay OK acceptance.

rollback_criteria.criterion: Return affected route to synchronous compatibility mode.
Disable publisher-backed write path if relay OK failures spike.
